applyRule: For each file, start with the exact UTF-8 preimage. Apply its transforms in listed order; require each before string to occur exactly once and replace that occurrence with after. Verify the candidate identity. Invert in reverse order with the same uniqueness checks and require byte-for-byte preimage equality.

nativeCppCallSitesReviewed.change: Consumes the returned offer ID, binds nonce/target/generation/dropRequest cleanup to the original dispatcher, and abandons any unreturned completion on failure.
Keeps its XAML deferral and actual OS result flow. Ignores the new return value, and applies the same owner/nonce Escape refusal as the parent proxy.

untouchedBehavior: No workflow, UIA, host, launcher, token, integrity, permission, SDK, dependency, or registration API substitution.
The broker still reports an accepted transfer only from the existing native completion path and app approval; cleanup cannot invent an OS result.
The parent hit-test geometry is unchanged; general affine transform support and competing parent-manager arbitration are not established by this correction.
All broker operations remain on the existing UI dispatcher; failed TryEnqueue has no inline fallback.
Source and target ownership, scope, and generation remain application-owned.
All existing strict native acceptance and package-receipt gates remain unchanged.
sourceChecks.timerOwnership: Tick cancels only while its sender is the current active timer. Start clears the preparation-timer reference before stopping it. Both deadlines remain unchanged.
sourceChecks.sourceStartFailureCleanup: Start protects the nonce copy, move of sourceReady, timer-reference clearing/Stop, and ready(true) in one try. Its catch attempts the moved ready(false) before exact Cancel(request) and rethrow; if copying failed before the move, Cancel still owns sourceReady. The existing source Claim guard prevents duplicate deferral/hook completion.

validation.actualTextTransformExecution: Completed in V8 on the exact three input and output strings, including forward uniqueness, complete inverse equality, hashes, and approved-probe equality.
validation.stateModelSimulation: Not used as a substitute for native execution.
laterNativeCases: Event allocation failure must prevent Offer.
Timeout, cancellation before/after callback registration, a racing approval, and duplicate/late broker callbacks must leave a single terminal result and a valid event lifetime.
An old queued cleanup must not cancel an offer with a different nonce, target, target generation, or dropRequest.
An unrelated surface, refused new drag, failed preparation, and failed hook installation must not release another source's Escape lease.
Disabled/unmounted/unloaded/disposed/rebound surfaces and stale held ParentDropTargets must refuse work; registration is invalidated before revoke or Close.
A tick from a preparation deadline cleared by Start, or from an older replaced timer, must not cancel the current active operation.

A nonce copy or timer Stop failure before ready(true) must still invoke sourceReady(false) for exactly-once cancellation, deferral and Escape cleanup while retaining the original error; a true callback that already claimed completion must not run again.

limits: No causal attribution of a previously observed heap-corruption exit is made.
No supported-host or elevated-host drag claim is made.
No tested-package archive or release acceptance is produced.
Immutable blob creation/readback only; no tree, commit, ref, PR, workflow, dispatch, rerun, or security mutation.
The timer identity guard is an ownership invariant; no delayed Tick callback was observed in the available native evidence.
